name: A10-0104/2025 – Veronika Vrecionová – Article 15, § 1 – Am 290
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the welfare of dogs and cats and their traceability
part_text: 1. Mutilations, including ear cropping, tail docking, claw removal or other partial or complete digit amputation, and resection of vocal cords or folds, shall be prohibited unless they are performed due to a medical indication established by a veterinarian. In such case, the procedure shall only be performed by a veterinarian under anaesthesia and prolonged analgesia.
